summary: A 1917 Aermotor LL-25 steel tower on Hadley Mountain in Saratoga County, NY, one of the state's first standard lookouts, still standing on a marked public trail.

facts.design: 40-ft Aermotor LL-25 steel tower with 7x7-ft metal cab

access.note: Tower stands in the Wilcox Lake Wild Forest on public land; a well-marked trail leads to the summit, maintained by the Hadley Mountain Fire Tower Committee. Most recent first-hand description is from 2017; current access not verified.

visit.trail_note: Well-marked trail to the summit; town plows road and trailhead parking in winter (2017 visit report)

facts.agency: NY Dept. of Environmental Conservation (cooperator: Hadley Mountain Fire Tower Committee)

Completed early in 1917 as a 40-ft Aermotor LL-25 steel tower with 7x7-ft cab; Wikipedia gives 1917 as the build year

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia gives 1917 as the build year. The register and Bill Starr describe a steel LL-25 begun late in 1916 and finished in early 1917, which the story follows. Wikipedia also reports a plaque dating the original wood tower to 1916 and the current steel tower to 1920; the story reports this as an unresolved disagreement rather than an event.

The register gives 2,680 ft (817 m) for the tower's elevation. The Adirondack Explorer gives the mountain ridgeline as 2,653 ft. These may refer to different points, so the story reports both figures.

notes_for_editor: The build date conflicts: register and Starr say construction ran late 1916 to early 1917 (story uses this), while Wikipedia gives 1917 and reports a plaque saying the original wood tower dates to 1916 and the current steel tower to 1920. The plaque was not read directly, only through Wikipedia. Access and staffing rest on 2017 visit reports and a 2017 Explorer article; no 2026 source was found, so current access and whether a steward is present now need confirming before any visit guidance. height_m 12.2 is converted from the register's 40 ft. Not used: andyarthur.org (both pages returned 403); hadleymtfiretower.org (the committee's site returned no text through fetch_text, so its history was not verified; a search snippet mentioned 1903 to 1915 fires and an Ohmer origin, which are unverified and left out); Facebook and Grokipedia search snippets. Photos: the register lists photo captions only, with no image URLs in the cache, so none recorded. Budget: 1 WebSearch, 6 successful page reads, 2 failed andyarthur reads. Brief record checked: elevation_m 816.9 matches the register's 817 m; no corrections proposed.
